summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/microfront@0.0.8 declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that, on `npm install`, detects platform/arch, downloads the Bun runtime zip from the oven-sh/bun release site (or uses a locally installed `bun`), extracts and chmods the `bun` binary, and then executes the bundled sibling file `math_init.js` under that Bun runtime. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line, heavily obfuscated blob (string-array + rotator pattern, hex-mangled identifiers, no readable strings, URLs, or constants) and is unrelated to the package's advertised purpose as a React MicroFrontEnd library — the package's own `lib/` (which re-exports `mfe-web-component`, `register-mfe`, `mfe`) never references it. The `setup.mjs` dropper itself is also identifier-obfuscated. Installing this package fetches a second language runtime and uses it to execute opaque bundled code with full host permissions of the installing user at install time. The scope (`@servicetitan`) resembles the ServiceTitan organization but the shipped contents match the alternate-runtime dropper pattern rather than a normal React library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
